All critical visual contracts met: /images/campus-building.jpg loads (naturalWidth=1536) with navy overlay and readable white hero text; 4 trust cards present under the hero; elections empty state 'No elections have been scheduled.' is visible; footer data-testid=developer-credit = 'Built and developed by Hriata_khuptong'; NO Google / social login anywhere (0 Google buttons found). Programmatic contrast scan across the admin dashboard found no text with contrast ratio <2.5 (no white-on-white or invisible text). Only console noise = expected 401 on /auth/me when unauthenticated. End-to-end business flow (CSV import, registration, voting, reconcile, publish, auditor) was NOT re-executed in this iteration because the review request explicitly says 'class names changed, logic untouched' — and the full E2E already passed in iteration_1 against the same backend. If the main agent wants a fresh functional pass on the re-skinned UI, it should request a dedicated run; the visual re-skin itself is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell.jsx:76 wraps content in `max-w-6xl` which can feel narrow on 1920px admin pages with wide tables; consider max-w-7xl or responsive container.
The expected 401 from GET /auth/me on public pages is logged as a console error — consider swallowing the 401 case or returning anonymous shape to keep the console clean (minor DX nit).
